title: 1화: 전설의 검을 뽑다
summary: 루나는 바위 속 빛을 보고 전설의 검에 도전한다.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Wide shot of the ancient mossy boulder with glowing runes, morning daylight, camera slowly pans to reveal a faint shimmer.

scenes.speaker: luna
scenes.shot: Medium shot of Luna walking toward the boulder, curious expression, soft sunlight filtering through trees.

scenes.speaker: ignis
scenes.shot: Close‑up of a floating crimson flame (Ignis) near the sword, orange eyes glowing, sparks crackling, low-angle lighting.

scenes.speaker: boris
scenes.shot: Medium shot of Boris standing confidently, iron shoulder plates gleaming, hand on his broadsword, confident grin.

scenes.speaker: luna
scenes.shot: Close‑up on Luna's face, eyebrows furrowed, slight gasp, warm light accentuating her freckles.

scenes.speaker: ignis
scenes.shot: Close‑up on Ignis, mischievous spark flickering, flame swirling around the sword hilt.

scenes.speaker: luna
scenes.shot: Medium shot of Luna placing both hands on the runic boulder, muscles tensed, camera focused on her grip.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Wide shot as the sword erupts from the stone, blinding flash, both Luna and Boris shield eyes, dust scattering.

scenes.speaker: ignis
scenes.shot: Close‑up on Ignis smirking, the sword now empty, a subtle dark silhouette hidden behind the flame, hinting at something deeper.

description: 루나가 전설의 검을 꺼내려는 순간, 예상치 못한 반전이 찾아온다. 하이판타지의 밝은 분위기와 깜짝 트위스트를 만나보세요.
